name: OCFree
description: Benchmark free OpenCode models and run repo development tasks with fallback.

opencodeBin.description: Path to the local OpenCode harness binary. Defaults to ~/.opencode/bin/opencode.

dataDir.description: Directory for state, jobs, tasks, and benchmarks. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/state/ocfree.

defaultTimeoutSec.description: Default per-run timeout in seconds (clamped 30..1800). Defaults to 300.

maxFallbackModels.description: Maximum models to try per dev task (clamped 1..5). Defaults to 3.

onlineRatingsUrl.description: Optional JSON URL for an online ratings registry. Defaults to BenchLM coding + SWE Atlas seed.

allowedRepoRoots.description: Directories that may contain task repositories. Repositories are resolved through fs.realpath and must stay inside one of these roots. Defaults to ["~/.openclaw/workspace"].
